schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: WITH TEMP_TABLE AS ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, S.SALE_DATE FROM PRODUCT AS P INNER JOIN SALES AS S ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM TEMP_TABLE WHERE SALE_DATE >= '2019-01-01' AND SALE_DATE <= '2019-03-31' AND PRODUCT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM TEMP_TABLE WHERE SALE_DATE < '2019-01-01' OR SALE_DATE > '2019-03-31' )
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: WITH TEMP_TABLE AS ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, S.SALE_DATE FROM PRODUCT AS P INNER JOIN SALES AS S ON P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM TEMP_TABLE WHERE SALE_DATE >= '2019-01-01' AND SALE_DATE <= '2019-03-31' AND PRODUCT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM TEMP_TABLE WHERE SALE_DATE < '2019-01-01' OR SALE_DATE > '2019-03-31' )
counterexample: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, UNIT_PRICE) VALUES (1, 'Product A', 100); INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 1, 1, '2019-02-15', 1, 100); INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 2, 2, '2019-04-01', 1, 100);
explanation: Q1 selects products whose all sales occurred within the date range '2019-01-01' to '2019-03-31'. Q2 selects products that have at least one sale in the range but no sales outside of it. These are not equivalent because Q1 excludes products with any sale outside the range, while Q2 only excludes products with any sale outside the range from the result set (still including one sale within the range).
counterexample_dsp: A product with one sale in the range and one sale outside the range will be excluded by Q1 but included by Q2.
